name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: ON-COMPOSE-ERROR-TRIGGER + REINIT-CERTVERIFIER, not for production: ports the confirmed-working reinitCertVerifier() mechanism (v0.4.34, validated by the user: reading now self-heals after every send, not just the first per session) from the proactive compose-open trigger onto the less disruptive reactive-on-send-failure trigger (nsIMsgComposeStateListener.ComposeProcessDone + auto-dismissed failure dialog + GenericSendMessage-wrap/auto-retry, previously shipped standalone as v0.4.29 / trunk's v0.6.0). Cleanup now only runs on an actual signing failure or at shutdown, each followed by the CertVerifier rebuild when it actually removed something.
